newsitem.title: CHINA: China says opposes U.S. criticism on human rights.
newsitem.headline: China says opposes U.S. criticism on human rights.

text.p: Beijing on Saturday accused the United States of using criticism of its human rights record as a pretext to interfere in China's internal affairs and said it firmly opposed such charges.

"The U.S. government turns a blind eye to the facts and distorts and condemns China's human rights situation, seriously violating the basic principles of international relations," Foreign Ministry spokesman Tang Guoqiang said in a statement.

"China voices its firm opposition to this," he said in China's first response to the annual U.S. human rights report that accused China of effectively silencing all public dissent against the Communist Party and government in 1996.
"The U.S. side should stop its wrong methods of using the pretext of human rights to interfere in China's internal affairs," Tang said.
